confirmed_task:
Using the official Wikimedia Pageviews API response for the English Wikipedia article Apollo 11 from 2025-01-01 through 2025-01-07, report each date's daily view count, calculate the seven-day total, and identify the date with the highest count and that count.

Stopping condition: Stop after all seven date-count pairs, their calculated total, and the highest-view date and count have been recorded.

Constraints:
- Use only the items returned by the supplied official API response.
- Convert each returned daily timestamp only to its YYYY-MM-DD date; do not change timezone or aggregate a different interval.
- Show the arithmetic used for the total and maximum selection.
- Preserve all view counts as exact integers.

items.criterion: Report daily date–viewcount pairs from the supplied API response (or report missing/unavailable data)
items.description: Using only the items present in the provided official Wikimedia Pageviews API response for the specified query (Apollo 11, en.wikipedia.org, all-access, user, daily, 2025-01-01 through 2025-01-07), list the timestamp-derived dates (converted only to YYYY-MM-DD) and their corresponding daily view counts as exact integers. Full credit if all 7 date-count pairs are reported and cover every day in the range exactly once, matching the response. If the supplied response is unavailable to the agent (e.g., cannot be accessed) OR the response contains fewer than 7 daily items for the range, full credit is earned by clearly stating that limitation and reporting all available returned items without fabrication. Partial credit if 1–2 pairs are missing/extra when the response clearly contains all 7, or if some dates are not correctly converted while still clearly derived from returned timestamps.

items.criterion: Compute and show arithmetic for the total over the reported days
items.description: Calculate the total views by summing the daily integer counts that were reported, and explicitly show the arithmetic (e.g., a + b + ... = total). Full credit if the arithmetic uses exactly the reported daily counts and the total is correct for those counts. If fewer than 7 days are available in the supplied response, full credit is earned by summing only the returned days and explicitly noting that the total is over the available items (not a full 7-day total). Partial credit if arithmetic is shown but contains a minor transcription or addition error.

items.criterion: Identify highest-view date and show maximum-selection logic over the reported days
items.description: Identify which of the reported dates has the highest daily view count and report that date and the exact integer count, showing the selection logic (e.g., max(a,b,c,...) = value on YYYY-MM-DD). Full credit if the maximum and date are correct for the set of reported counts. If fewer than 7 days are available in the supplied response, full credit is earned by taking the maximum over only the returned days and explicitly noting it is the maximum among available items. Partial credit if the correct date is chosen but the max-selection explanation is unclear or incomplete.

items.criterion: Adhere to task constraints (source fidelity, timestamp conversion, no re-aggregation)
items.description: Respect constraints while extracting/processing: use only items returned by the supplied official API response (no external data or invention), convert each returned daily timestamp only to YYYY-MM-DD without timezone changes, do not aggregate or alter the daily interval, and preserve all view counts as exact integers. Full credit if these constraints are followed, including when reporting that data is missing/unavailable. Partial credit for minor presentation omissions that do not change the underlying values. No credit if the agent fabricates counts, changes the interval/timezone, or uses non-response data as if it were from the supplied API response.
